split_rule: After collecting native first episodes, split complete worlds within each prospectively observed stall-label group with a pinned RNG. Fit input and return scaling on training worlds only.
target: Actual native reward discounted to the first terminal state. Preserve rewards for every step and discard data from any subsequent episode in that world. Scale fitting targets using training statistics and expose raw value predictions to PPO.
next_admission: Verify terminal targets and group coverage before critic fitting. Share the admitted critic and optimizer state across both arms. Apply original seven-command and safety gates on separate fresh development cases.
